gettingStarted: How would you like to use AI?
codexIntroduction: ① Signed in to Codex: use your current login without a regular API key. Skills, file operations and State tasks remain in the existing workflow.
apiIntroduction: ② Your own API: choose a provider → enter the URL and key → fetch or enter a model → save → test → assign tasks.
localIntroduction: ③ Local models: start the OpenAI-compatible server in LM Studio or Ollama, then enter its loopback URL and choose a loaded model. Check the server, port and loaded models if it cannot connect.
addressAndKeyHelp: Base URL is the API service root, not a model name or a complete /chat/completions path. Model ID must match the provider’s identifier. The provider issues your API key, which is stored in Windows Credential Manager.
parametersHelp: Temperature controls randomness in supported models; Top P controls sampling. Max Output Tokens limits output tokens, not the manuscript’s character count. Parameters with unknown support are not sent automatically. Verify capabilities against official documentation. The default preset leaves temperature to the provider; Conservative and Creative apply only where support is confirmed.
agentBoundaryHelp: Codex Agent performs permission-controlled workspace and file tasks. Regular APIs generate text and structured proposals; they do not run project Skills, Memory Commit or file operations. OpenAI compatibility and Responses support do not guarantee Codex tool compatibility. Custom Agent support remains unverified in this version.
billingHelp: A ChatGPT subscription does not include OpenAI API credit. Third-party providers bill separately, and generation tests may cost money. Local inference uses your computer’s resources. Cost estimates use returned Usage and your configured prices; missing usage is UNKNOWN. Budget warnings do not replace provider spending limits.
privacyHelp: Before sending a category of content to a remote service, the app shows the provider, model and content categories, and lets you cancel. The manuscript assistant sends only selected text by default. Other modules use bounded context packages. Regular API records do not retain full prompts or output by default; suggestions you choose to save are retained separately. Backups contain non-sensitive settings only. Re-enter keys on another computer.
authenticationHelp: 401 / invalid key: check that the key belongs to this service and re-enter it. Never paste a key into a manuscript.
permissionHelp: 403: check model permissions and account access.
notFoundHelp: 404: check the service root, protocol and model ID. Enter a model manually if listing is unsupported.
quotaHelp: 429 / insufficient balance: check billing, quotas and rate limits. Wait before retrying manually.
timeoutHelp: Timeout / disconnection: execution is unknown. Check provider records before repeating a potentially paid request.
streamingHelp: Streaming unsupported: mark streaming as unsupported for this model and disable it before retrying.
localServerHelp: Local model unavailable: start LM Studio Server or Ollama and check the localhost port.
skillsHelp: Skills unavailable: switch back to Codex. Regular APIs do not become Agents automatically.
credentialHelp: Credential Manager unavailable: explicitly choose a session-only key. It expires when the app exits and is never stored as plaintext.
configurationSaved: Settings saved. Keys are excluded from projects, logs and backups.
codexIndependentBackend: Independent Agent backend · retains the existing login, Skills, project isolation and task system.
deleteProviderConfirmation: Delete this provider and its stored system key?
deleteKeyConfirmation: Delete the key? Non-sensitive settings will be retained.
baseUrlHelp: API service root: HTTPS for remote services; local HTTP is restricted to loopback. Do not enter a full endpoint path. Changing the URL or authentication header removes the old key, so re-enter it.
keyPlaceholder: API Key (leave blank to keep the current key)
keyHelp: A key from your provider. It is stored only in the credential vault; the frontend cannot read the complete key.
fetchSavedModels: Fetch available models using saved settings
modelListingHelp: A failed model list does not mean the text API is unavailable. Capabilities are not inferred from names, and UNKNOWN parameters are not forced into requests.
modelIdentifierHelp: Use the provider’s actual model identifier.
capabilityOverrideWarning: Manual capability overrides may be incompatible. Check official documentation or run a lightweight test. Enabling tool capability does not grant file permissions.
acknowledgeTestCost: I understand the test may cost money. Send only “Reply only OK.”
routingHelp: Explicit task models take precedence over defaults. Failed requests are not forwarded to another provider automatically. File operations and complex workflows remain with Codex.
retainFullHistory: Save full API output history (may contain private text; use with care)
historyPrivacyHelp: Default records contain only time, task, model, usage and status. Revision candidates you choose to save use the existing revision history.
usageHelp: UNKNOWN means the service returned no Usage. Costs are estimates based on your configured prices, not official bills.
priceOrUsageUnknown: Price not set or usage unknown
noUsageRecords: No API request records yet. Usage is never fabricated for requests that did not run.
selectionOnlyCandidateGuidance: Only the current selection is sent; select some text first if nothing is selected. Copy the candidate yourself or confirm it in the selection Diff. It does not automatically overwrite the manuscript.
selectionContextScopeSuffix: selected characters + author instructions; excludes the full Canon, other chapters, and reference materials.
standardApiAuthorInstructions: Author instructions for the standard API
selectionPolishingToolbarGuidance: To polish a selection, use the manuscript toolbar, which supports saving candidates, viewing a Diff, and manual acceptance.
